title: Barcelona Overview: Old Town
text: We had a private tour with Katty.   I was impressed by her knowledge of Old Town, Montjuïc and surrounding area.  She was very accommodating to what we wanted to see.   Going on a private tour is the best way to learn about the city.
author: dhleyva

title: Excellent Experience
text: Katy was an excellent guide. We’d been on many tours this week, but she taught us things we hadn’t yet heard.

title: Great Tour
text: Late afternoon was the perfect time for this tour. The sunset views on Montjuic were magical. Lots of walking! Stephanie was a lot of fun and very communicative prior to the tour.

title: Beautiful Montjuic
text:
My wife and I very much enjoyed the tour given by our guide Montse.  It was an evening tour and due to high winds some of the attractions were closed. This did not interfere with the tour at all. Montse was able to deliver an excellent experience.  She gave a true Catalan vibe in both her enthusiasm and perspective on Catalan history.  She took great care of us in all categories.  

Thank you Montse 😊
author: debbiemL8635DS

title: Must watch tour
text: Kathy was great and knowledgeable. Took plenty of time to explain everything. I would recommend to any one single or with family
author: Global372178

title: Amazing and friendly tour
text: Montse was an incredible guide — friendly, caring, and truly passionate about the area. She brought us to amazing local gems we never would’ve found on our own and shared so much knowledge along the way. We had a wonderful time and learned a lot. Highly recommend touring with her!
author: jasonbS7275VG

title: The Best Guide in Barcelona: Montse Brought the City’s History, Culture, and Beauty to Life
text: From the moment we met Montse, her love for Catalunya was contagious. She skillfully guided us through Old Town, the ancient city walls, and Montjuïc Castle while sharing the stories, language, and traditions that make Catalan culture so unique. We traveled like locals on the metro, bus, and cable cars, and she captured beautiful photos along the way. Truly the best tour guide we’ve ever had—she felt like family by the end.
author: Ksharhea

title: Guide to Montjuic
text: Monserrat, the guide, very polite and you can see that she knows a lot about Catalonia. We ended up going to a typical Basque tapas bar.
author: maxis739

title: Best Evening Views of Barcelona.
text: Miguel was great. I had two meeting points, and went to the wrong one. He worked with us and we still met up to have a great tour. It was a very small group and pricier than a larger group, but well worth it. Our tour was during sunset, and it was a great evening with a beautiful sunset. Since we had already been in the city a few days we weren’t overwhelmed with the tapas. They were good, but we had had them already.
